rules.render: Only finite-distance objects have 3D positions; uncertain or missing-distance sources remain in a sky-only list. Screen-space glyphs are not physical radii.
rules.scale: Local system geometry uses physical km converted to parsecs. Black hole reference Schwarzschild radius assumes zero spin; neutron star radius is model dependent.
rules.dataLifecycle: Snapshot catalogue versions and attribution. Do not fetch massive catalogues from browser on every page load.
